why: Searches found only a Dec 2025 arXiv preprint (2512.15763) proposing a computational/parametrization method for finding representations of specific integers, and unrelated variants (function-field sums of three cubes, consecutive-integer variants). No source claims a proof, disproof, or resolution of whether the mod-9 necessary condition is sufficient, nor any new admissible value settled; Wikipedia's own article still describes the characterization as open.
